quick_skim.title: Acoustic-based Guidance for Automatic Docking of Holonomic AUVs
quick_skim.abstract: This paper describes a system to automatically dock an AUV onto a docking station without precise knowledge of the position and orientation of the latter, in the presence of unknown ocean currents, using a fully acoustic sensing architecture. The system relies on a pair of Ultrashort Baseline sensors, one onboard the vehicle and one installed on a seabed-resident docking station, enabling operation in low-visibility environments where cameras are ineffective. Relative orientation is estimated by a nonlinear complementary filter on $SO(3)$, while an Extended Kalman Filter provides relative position, supplying pose estimates to a geometric controller on $SE(3)$ that executes the docking manoeuvre. The complete system is implemented in a dedicated software suite and validated in simulation and water trials.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This paper presents an acoustic guidance system that docks an AUV onto a station of unknown pose, estimating relative orientation on SO(3) and relative position via EKF for SE(3) control.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 在低能见度水下环境中相机失效且对接站位姿未知，自动对接十分困难。本文提出全声学制导系统，利用一对超短基线传感器，用SO(3)上的非线性互补滤波器估计相对姿态，用扩展卡尔曼滤波估计相对位置，并驱动SE(3)几何控制器完成对接。系统在未知洋流下实现了可靠对接。该工作为相对位姿估计与目标接近控制提供了完整范例。
